args.body: Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Based on the text I could access, your site clearly identifies itself as your personal website and makes your email easy to find. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect to find—projects, interests, or examples of your work—to give it more personality and context. I could only review the text returned from the site, so I can't comment on its visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Based on the text I could access, sharing your interest in hiking gives the blog a personal touch. I'd love to see a short introduction explaining what you'll write about, along with hiking stories or trail recommendations to give readers a reason to explore further. I could only review the text returned from the site, so I can't comment on its visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her site, and sent Dora and Eve feedback via direct message.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a personal introduction and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested expanding on her interest in hiking with stories or trail recommendations.

The feedback was based on the accessible website text, not visual design.
